authLanding.intro: Shopeto helps your organisation track daily cash, bank movements, and volunteer time — all from your phone or tablet.
authLanding.forWho: Built for charity shops and small teams
authLanding.forWhoDesc: Whether you run one shop or several, keep everything in one place. Data stays with your organisation, not with individual devices.
authLanding.featureCashDesc: Log income and expenses with dates and tags. See net cash position at a glance.
authLanding.featureBankDesc: Record deposits and withdrawals. Track balance alongside your cash ledger.
authLanding.featureVolunteersDesc: Log hours per volunteer, see weekly charts and totals. Manage your team list.
authLanding.featureReportsDesc: Export to PDF or send by email. Choose date ranges and sections. Print-friendly A4 layouts.
authLanding.featureOrgsDesc: Switch between organisations in one account. Each org has its own data and members.
authLanding.availabilityPwaDesc: Add to your home screen for quick access. Works offline for viewing; syncs when back online.
authLanding.availabilityMobileDesc: Designed for phones first. Large tap targets, readable text, no pinching.
authLanding.availabilitySecureDesc: Email sign-in. Your data is stored securely and only visible to your organisation.
authLanding.cta: Sign in above to get started
